datasets.name: AccStateData
datasets.sql:
select
  arc.DATDATE as ArchiveDate,
  arc.ACC_ID as AccID,
  abs(arc.OSTAT) as Amount,
  abs(arc.POK_OSTAT) as LAmount,
  abs(arc.OBR_D) as DebitTurnover,
  abs(arc.POK_OBR_D) as DebitLTurnover,
  abs(arc.OBR_K) as CreditTurnover,
  abs(arc.POK_OBR_K) as CreditLTurnover
from archost arc
where arc.acc_id = :AccID
order by arc.datdate --desc

datasets.name: Account
datasets.sql:
SELECT   
   ACCOUNT.RowID, ID, kli_id, op_id, acc_no, val_acc, NAME, open_dat, close_dat,
   DECODE (close_dat, NULL, 1, 2) AS status, bal_cn1, bal_cn2, bal_cn3,
   bal_cn4, filial, sim_otcet, tipacc, LIMIT, old_acc_no, pair_acc,
   insider
FROM ACCOUNT
ORDER BY 
   :title
